additional_info.subject: Error Descrition
additional_info.body:
Dear Support Team,
I’m reopening the case regarding the FRERES LUMIERE 04 charging
station (MP / R3: 170001705 – Manufacturer: SIEMENS – DC), as
the error DC2 Errorcode: 8 – No active converters found has
reappeared.
This issue was already the subject of a previous ticket:
Ticket ID: 0421762
Created earlier and followed up on 12/05
A converter was diagnosed as faulty and replaced during an on-site
intervention on 21/05 (report received and marked OK)
Despite this, the same error has now reoccurred, and the station is
not operational.
Could you please review the situation and advise on further
corrective actions?
Thank you for your support.

additional_info.subject: ID0431700-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R3 170001705] No active converters found CRM:00642002358
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
Please refer to the steps below for on-site execution.
We have analyzed the charger and identified a problem with the fast shutdown wiring. We need to schedule a site intervention to check the following:
Since the converter error E:52 is user-generated and indicates a failure in the fast shutdown check, we should examine the wiring. If possible, please bring a spare KF13 with you.
Check the connection on the +F03-XD6 terminal.
Check the connections on XD9.2A/B and XD14.1A/B.
Check the connections on +F03 XD5 for the 12VDC supply.
Check the connection on Switching MG1-MG2.
Also, please refer to the following KAs for troubleshooting-
1.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_Sicharge_D_Converter_ Missing converter in DC1,DC2,DC3,DC4 -
2.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_Power Converter_Missing converters - Dynamics 365
